Entry requirements for international students
Whether you’re going to study in Melbourne or from your home country, you need to meet the minimum English language and academic requirements for the course you want to study.
Academic requirements
Most courses require specific academic requirements, such as an equivalent overseas qualification. This will be assessed at the time of your application.
To find the academic requirements based on your country and course, select the relevant information from the following drop-down options.
Note: for entry requirements relating to master degrees by research or doctorate degrees, please visit the entry requirements for research degrees page.
Which level of study are you interested in at Swinburne?
Please select

To confirm entry requirements using an overseas qualification that does not appear on the list, please call 1300 275 794 (within Australia)
+61 9214 8444 (outside Australia) operating hours 9am - 5.30pm AEST or complete the enquiry form.
Submit
Please reach out to your education agent or get in touch with our team if you need further information about academic requirements for Swinburne Foundation Program, UniLink Bridging Program, UniLink diplomas, vocational education (TAFE), undergraduate courses (bachelor degrees) and postgraduate courses (master degrees by coursework).
English language requirements
Each course offered by Swinburne has a minimum English language requirement for entry. Your course may also have the Pearson Test of English as an additional prerequisite.
